name: tidyinbox
description: Clean promotional email in Gmail or Outlook. Install TidyInbox, then invoke it with @tidyinbox in ChatGPT Desktop.

interface.longDescription: Install TidyInbox from the tidyinbox-marketplace in ChatGPT Desktop, connect Gmail or Outlook, then start a new chat and type @tidyinbox. Set a mailbox, search scope, and goal. For a broad inbox cleanup, it groups likely promotions by sender for your review before making changes. TidyInbox runs only when invoked; it does not monitor your mailbox in the background.
defaultPrompt: @tidyinbox review promotional email in my Outlook Inbox from the past 60 days, group it by sender, and make no changes
@tidyinbox unsubscribe from [sender] in [Gmail or Outlook] and move its promotional mail to recoverable deletion, keeping receipts and account notices
